title: テイルズ オブ エターニア

layouts.notes: The line is whole in its buffer from the moment its window opens and stays after it closes. The window's record at 0x800D3664: state at +0x22 (0 closed, 1 opening, 2 closing, 3 open), the address being typed at +0x14, a pointer to the speaker's name at +0x18. `waiting`: the typing address stands on the terminator, so the line is typed out. Codes seen: 03 and a colour, 07 and a style (07 01 bold, 07 00 normal); there may be others. No `shown`: the typing position is an address, not a count. From a headless replay of the opening; talk on a map, shops, battles, menus and choices not reached.

sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 13,490, utf16le 48 characters of prose-like text
